title: Redis Data Types
subtitle: Strings, lists, sets, sorted sets, hashes, and bitmaps

content.text: Redis is not just a string cache. It supports rich data structures that map to common programming patterns.

content.code:
# String
SET user:1:name "Alice"
GET user:1:name

# Hash (like a mini-document)
HSET user:1 name "Alice" age 30
HGETALL user:1

# List
RPUSH queue task1 task2 task3
LPOP queue

# Set
SADD tags "redis" "cache"
SMEMBERS tags

# Sorted Set
ZADD leaderboard 100 "alice" 200 "bob"
ZRANGE leaderboard 0 -1 WITHSCORES

questions.question: Which Redis type maintains elements in order by score?
questions.explanation: Sorted Sets store members with a floating-point score and keep them ordered.
